description: This file defines the KamonCounter class, an implementation of a Counter interface using Kamon metrics library. It provides methods for creating, tagging, incrementing, resetting, and retrieving counter metrics, with internal state management and logging.

classes.name: KamonCounter
classes.description: An immutable class implementing Counter, providing Kamon-based metrics counter functionality with tagging, incrementing, resetting, and snapshot capabilities.

methods.name: newCounter
methods.description: Factory methods to create new KamonCounter instances with specified name and optional tags.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Returns a new KamonCounter with an added tag key-value pair.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Returns a new KamonCounter with additional tags merged.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific tag by key.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Returns all tags associated with the counter.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increments the counter by a specified number of times.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the counter to zero, if supported.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the KamonCounter instance.
